tools.name: ask_bitcoin
tools.description: Ask a question about Bitcoin, Lightning Network, Nostr, or related topics. Powered by Maximum Sats AI (Llama 3.3 70B). First query per IP per day is free. Accepts L402 (Lightning) or x402 (USDC) payment.

prompt.description: Your question about Bitcoin, Lightning, Nostr, or crypto

tools.name: retry_with_payment
tools.description: Retry a paid query after paying the Lightning invoice. Provide the payment_hash from the original response.

payment_hash.description: The payment_hash from the payment_required response

tools.name: wot_score
tools.description: Look up the Web of Trust score for a Nostr pubkey. Based on PageRank over the Nostr follow graph (51K+ nodes, 618K+ edges).

pubkey.description: Nostr hex pubkey to look up

tools.name: wot_top
tools.description: Get the top Web of Trust scores on Nostr. Shows the most trusted pubkeys based on PageRank analysis of the follow graph.

limit.description: Number of top scores to return (max 100)
